data.name: Jumayna
data.gender_notes: Jumayna is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is praised and glorified, a symbol of beauty and nobility. The name Jumayna carries the meaning “Glorious or Illustrious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Jumayna usually hope their child will grow to embody glorious or illustrious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: According to Quranic verse 114:4, Jumayna is a term used to describe the beauty and majesty of Allah.
data.etymology: Jumayna belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glorious or Illustrious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jumayna total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
